name: burrow
description: Search, read, share and organize the files on your Burrow NAS from Claude Code, approving each call: the Burrow MCP tools plus /burrow:find, /burrow:share, /burrow:links, /burrow:changes and /burrow:drop.

mcp_url.title: Burrow MCP endpoint
mcp_url.description: Your Burrow's MCP address, shown under Settings → MCP and API tokens, for example https://share.example.com/mcp. On the public address, also tick Settings → Public port → Also serve MCP.

api_token.title: Burrow API token
api_token.description: A token from Settings → MCP and API tokens (it starts with brw_). Claude sees and shares exactly what the account that made it can.
